svg.text: Use your normal row plus one spare row. Front nine shown; the back nine works the same way.
Score in the middle, as usual.
Optional: a dot on the side you missed the green.
Circles and squares for birdies/bogeys are fine.
approach yards / chip / first putt feet
Chip lie: r rough, s sand, f fairway or fringe.
Chip distance in yards (paces are fine).
Add s to the approach (165s) if it was from a bunker.
3 The app works out the rest
score minus putts is at most par minus 2
score minus putts minus shots to reach the green
Missing a number? The app uses a typical
value and marks it as approximate.
